frame.problem: The team needed one moment each week to look at KRs and decide. When do we hold the weekly review?

vars.name: Time to act on it
vars.ctx: Decisions taken in the review should be acted on the same week.

vars.name: Attendance
vars.ctx: All five people must be able to attend.

vars.name: Freshness of data
vars.ctx: Numbers must include the week's results.

opts.name: Friday afternoon
opts.desc: Review the week that ends, plan the next.
